attempt_003.interpretation: The optional direct API observation stopped before invoking the reconciler. No response body was saved; the subsequent run removed this redundant probe and used the real reconciler as the single upstream reader.

attempt_004.interpretation: The combined invocation/validation stage did not preserve the CLI response. Instrumentation then split the stage and persisted a safe structured reconciliation result.

attempt_005.diagnosis: The validator incorrectly required a top-level resource on the inconclusive error result; the actual CLI schema carries the resource under error.details.resource. The validator and tests were corrected.
